sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement (§1 Special Links, §5 Associate Identification, §7 Disclaimers, §12 Monitoring)
sources.finding: Requires proper tagged Special Links and clear, prominent display of the required Associate qualifying-purchases statement under §5. Prohibits unauthorized public claims about the Agreement.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies & Linking Tools (`link.amazon` Short-Link Compliance Status)
sources.finding: Special Links must use formats provided by Amazon and track in Associates Central. Exact compliance and attribution status of supplied `https://link.amazon/...` short links is unresolved (do NOT claim they are invalid); validate one Special Link per product in the enrolled `shopnow047c-20` workflow and confirm tracking reports before scaling.

sources.title: Associates Program Standard Commission Income Statement (Table 1 Fixed Rates)
sources.finding: Fixed Standard Commission Income rates list Kitchen at 4.50% and Home, Home Improvement, Tools, Furniture, Lawn & Garden at 3.00% of Qualifying Revenue, paid ~60 days post-month-end.

sources.title: Understanding ASINs: Amazon Standard Identification Number
sources.finding: Defines ASIN as a 10-character alphanumeric catalog identifier (distinct from 9-character mixed-case `link.amazon` share path tokens).

sources.title: Associates Program Participation Requirements (§2 Trademarks, §14 No Incentives, §22 No Framing, §29 No Self-Purchase, §30 No Link Cloaking)
sources.finding: Prohibits incentivized clicks, self-orders through Special Links, framing Amazon pages, unauthorized seller logos, and URL cloaking that obscures the referring site.

sources.title: Product Advertising API (PA-API 5.0) Access & Usage Requirements
sources.finding: Requires an approved Associates account and PA-API credentials to request programmatic prices, images, and reviews; static un-refreshed prices risk policy violation.

sources.title: FTC Guides Concerning the Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising (16 CFR Part 255, §255.5 Material Connections)
sources.finding: Mandates clear, conspicuous disclosure of unexpected material connections (including affiliate commissions) where consumers can notice it easily without hunting or scrolling past endorsements.

sources.title: Associates Central Tag & Link Checker Guidance
sources.finding: Enrolled Associates must verify destination and tracking tag attribution inside Associates Central without placing self-purchases.

sources.title: Associates Central Earnings, Clicks & Orders Reporting Guide
sources.finding: First-party Associates reports are the sole authoritative source for Amazon-counted clicks, shipped items, and reported orders.

sources.finding: Observed redirect destination for `https://link.amazon/B0hmGG4m2` on 2026-11-20. Verified brand `Art3d`, model `A17999`, dimensions `7.72 x 4.33 x 0.79 in`, weight `3.52 oz`.

sources.title: ORDORA Official Storefront on Amazon
sources.finding: Confirms ORDORA brand storefront linked from ASIN `B08DY9HRWD`.

sources.title: Amazon Customer Help — Typical Price & List Price Methodology
sources.finding: Defines Typical Price as 90-day customer-paid median (excluding limited-time promos) and List Price as supplier-provided reference price validated against recent sales.

sources.title: Qualify Your Outbound Links to Google (`rel="sponsored"`)
sources.finding: Recommends qualifying all affiliate and paid links with `rel="sponsored"` whether created manually or dynamically.

sources.title: Google Web Search Spam Policies — Thin Affiliation vs. Original Editorial Value
sources.finding: Distinguishes thin scraped merchant copy from original buyer checklists, measurement guidance, clear authorship, and category comparisons.

sources.title: Build and Submit a Sitemap (`sitemap.xml` & `robots.txt`)
sources.finding: UTF-8 XML sitemaps at the site root referenced in `robots.txt` (`Sitemap: ...`) cover all descendant URLs.

sources.title: Consolidate Duplicate URLs (`rel="canonical"`)
sources.finding: Every HTML document specifies a single self-consistent `https://kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/DIYHOME1/...` canonical URL.

sources.title: Get Started with Search Console — Ownership Verification & Query Measurement
sources.finding: Search Console query performance requires external domain/URL-prefix verification by the site owner before query-driven topic selection begins.

sources.title: USDA FSIS — Air Fryers and Food Safety
sources.finding: Advises against overcrowding air fryer baskets (which restricts rapid air circulation) and recommends verifying internal food temperature with a food thermometer.

sources.title: GitHub Pages Official Documentation
sources.finding: Repository `kanlerxz87-cyber/DIYHOME1` serves static files from `main` `/` over HTTPS at `https://kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/DIYHOME1/` with `.nojekyll`.

sources.title: FTC Disclosures 101 & Associate Link-Level Disclosure Guidance
sources.finding: Requires plain, unambiguous disclosure language (`paid link`, `sponsored`, plus the Operating Agreement Associate statement) placed where readers see it before/with affiliate links.

parallel_passes.implementation: The shipped primary row is Home, Products, Comparisons, Guides, Search, RSS. Every operational surface — Executive summary, Source register, Product-intent & ledger, Flagged for review, Measurement & events, Automation & gate, How we verify, Disclosures — sits in one "Site desk" group and is repeated in the footer. No dashboard link appears in the primary row.
parallel_passes.source_supports: Google recommends organizing a site logically so search engines and users can understand how pages relate.

parallel_passes.implementation: feed.xml is generated by scripts/build.mjs on every build, advertised with <link rel="alternate" type="application/rss+xml"> in the head of every published page, and checked by scripts/validate.mjs for well-formed XML and resolvable item links. The channel carries the three elements the RSS 2.0 specification requires: title, link and description.
parallel_passes.source_supports: The RSS 2.0 specification lists title, link and description as the required channel elements.

parallel_passes.implementation: One canonical host on all 21 published pages. sitemap.xml lists 21 URLs and scripts/validate.mjs fails the build if any is missing or points at a page that does not exist. robots.txt carries a Sitemap: directive but is served at /DIYHOME1/robots.txt, not the host root a crawler reads (flag F14), so the noindex meta tags on /search/ and /404.html are the actual control. The Search Console property itself is not verified (flag F04).
parallel_passes.source_supports: Google documents the sitemap format and the sitemap index location; property verification happens in Search Console.

parallel_passes.implementation: Reader capture is a public RSS 2.0 subscribe callout plus a checklist that runs in the visitor's own browser. No email address is requested, no cookie is set, and scripts/validate.mjs fails the build if any third-party subresource, script, image or stylesheet is added.
parallel_passes.source_supports: FTC business guidance treats collecting only what you need and being clear about data practices as the baseline.

flagged_items.finding: Initial `main` branch contained only a 10-byte `README.md` (`# DIYHOME1`) with no `COORDINATION.md`, no disclosures, and no Pages HTML.
flagged_items.action_required: Resolved via coordinated branch integration and GitHub Pages deployment; documented for audit provenance.

flagged_items.item: Duplicate Input URL (submitted link 2 == submitted link 3)
flagged_items.finding: `https://link.amazon/B03QDuGdo` was submitted twice in the prompt product list (lines 2 and 3, followed by a blank line before line 4).
flagged_items.action_required: Retained as a distinct audit row in `data/product-intents.csv` (marked as an exact duplicate) and deduplicated on buyer-facing category pages. Operator should confirm whether a fourth distinct product URL was intended.

flagged_items.finding: All three supplied `link.amazon` path tokens begin with `B0` and have 9 mixed-case characters, superficially resembling ASINs, but official ASINs are 10 uppercase alphanumeric characters (`B08FKW9JRM`, `B0BSKQW2T2`, `B08DY9HRWD`).
flagged_items.action_required: Never treat `link.amazon` tokens as ASINs. Keep `observedRedirect` separate from `intendedAsin` until operator confirms intended ASINs.

flagged_items.finding: Observed redirects from `https://link.amazon/...` carried `btn_type=ss` and `sprefix=diy+home+upgrades` without `tag=shopnow047c-20`. Per `VS02`, we do NOT claim `link.amazon` short links are invalid; their Associates compliance/attribution status is unresolved.
flagged_items.action_required: Generate one validated Special Link (`https://www.amazon.com/dp/<ASIN>?tag=shopnow047c-20`) per confirmed product inside the enrolled Associates account and verify click/tracking reporting without self-purchasing.

flagged_items.item: Operator Product-Intent Confirmation (all four submitted links)
flagged_items.finding: While HTTP redirects on 2026-11-20 landed on `B08FKW9JRM`, `B0BSKQW2T2`, and `B08DY9HRWD`, an observed redirect alone does not prove operator product intent.
flagged_items.action_required: Populate `intended_asin`, `official_listing_url`, `confirmation_date` and `confirmation_source` in `data/product-intents.csv` only after operator sign-off.

flagged_items.item: Editorial Hypotheses vs. Observed DIY Catalog Mismatch
flagged_items.finding: The brief's working guide hypotheses focus on air fryers and multi-function kitchen appliances, whereas the three observed `link.amazon` products are DIY wall-treatment tools (`B08FKW9JRM`), an under-cabinet paper towel holder (`B0BSKQW2T2`), and an under-cabinet cookware rack (`B08DY9HRWD`).
flagged_items.action_required: Both the 4 kitchen appliance editorial guides and 3 dedicated DIY upgrade category guides are published without inventing unsubmitted air-fryer ASINs. Operator should confirm target niche alignment.

flagged_items.finding: `UPC` is absent from official specification tables on `B08FKW9JRM` and `B0BSKQW2T2` (verified only on `B08DY9HRWD` as `655100721821`). `Date First Available` is absent from the rendered specification tables on `B0BSKQW2T2` and `B08DY9HRWD` (verified only on `B08FKW9JRM` as `August 11, 2020`).
flagged_items.action_required: Left blank in all verification tables per strict zero-inference policy; populate only if confirmed via Seller/Manufacturer documentation or PA-API 5.0.

flagged_items.finding: On `https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08FKW9JRM`, Technical Details lists `Item Package Quantity: 3`, whereas the feature bullets list 5 components (large smoother, blue squeegee, utility knife, replacement blades, measuring tape), and a California Proposition 65 warning link appears.
flagged_items.action_required: Verify exact included piece count on physical packaging or PA-API `ItemInfo` before publishing piece-count guarantees.

flagged_items.item: `B08DY9HRWD` Pan Size Copy (`11"` vs `12"`) & Newer Model Banner (`B0BYYTQMTR`)
flagged_items.finding: On `https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08DY9HRWD`, the title states `Fits Lightweight Cookware Up to 11"` (`10 lbs` per tier), bullet #4 states `up to 12 inches`, and Amazon displays a newer heavy-duty model banner (`B0BYYTQMTR`, `20.8"`, `120 lbs`).
flagged_items.action_required: Disclosed in the Cabinet & Cookware buying guide so cast-iron owners check weight limits; confirm whether `B08DY9HRWD` or `B0BYYTQMTR` is the intended target.

flagged_items.item: Dynamic Pricing, Prime-Exclusive Tiering & Review Staleness Gate
flagged_items.finding: Observed listings showed time-limited Black Friday deals and Prime-exclusive pricing (`B08DY9HRWD` Prime deal vs Regular List Price). Static prices and review counts become stale quickly without live PA-API 5.0 / Creators API refresh.
flagged_items.action_required: Static retail prices, star ratings, and commission forecasts remain omitted from buyer cards until authorized PA-API credentials and timestamped caching are active.

flagged_items.finding: `B0BSKQW2T2` and `B08DY9HRWD` sit under `Home & Kitchen › Kitchen & Dining`. Amazon's Standard Commission Income table lists `Kitchen` at `4.50%` and `Home` / `Home Improvement` / `Tools` at `3.00%`.
flagged_items.action_required: Confirm actual SKU commission category assignment from first-party Associates Central fee-schedule reports; no revenue forecast is presented.

flagged_items.item: External Search Console Verification & Production Analytics Endpoint
flagged_items.finding: GitHub Pages serves static assets only; `analyticsEndpoint` in `data/catalog.json` is intentionally empty (`""`) until `analytics/server.py` is deployed on operator TLS infrastructure, and Search Console ownership requires operator token placement.
flagged_items.action_required: Deploy `analytics/server.py` behind HTTPS, set `analyticsEndpoint`, verify Search Console ownership, and import only authorized Associates CSV reports into `data/campaign.csv`.

register_note: Snapshot register from the 2026-11-20 verification pass. Entries here use the VS__ prefix and deliberately do not share identifiers with data/sources.json (S__), which is the canonical citation register rendered on /sources/ — site badges use those S__ codes, never VS__ ones. Until 2026-11-21 both files used S__ for different documents, so the same label meant two different pages (flag F17). Sources added to the canonical register on 2026-11-21 (S27-S29, after S26 was taken by the robots.txt document) are recorded only in data/sources.json.
